example.title: Jet Inn, 4542 Slauson Avenue
example.place: View Park-Windsor Hills, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A c. 1970 three-storey motor hotel: a long block of tan-and-cream panels with rows of room windows and doors off open galleries, a flat roof with a fascia sign, a low wall and a car park on the avenue. Two photos (2022). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
